passages.title: Supplier Portal — Banking Details Verification
passages.body:
To: Approved Suppliers
From: Accounts Payable Support
Subject: Required verification before the November payment cycle

We are moving supplier records to a new payment portal on November 2. Existing supplier accounts will remain active, but vendors must verify the name of the account holder before [1] _____ any changes to their banking details. This extra step has been introduced after several invoices were linked to outdated account numbers.

[2] _____ the short notice, the verification process should take no more than ten minutes. A secure link will be sent to the registered contact person rather than to individual employees. If your contact has changed, please ask your purchasing representative to update the name before using the link.

All submitted information will be checked [3] _____ our payment-security guidelines. Requests received after October 30 may not be processed in time for the first November payment cycle.

Please retain the reference number shown after each submission. [4] _____ These records will be needed if there is a discrepancy during the first payment cycle. If you have questions, contact the Accounts Payable Support team rather than creating a second supplier account.

passages.title: Compliance Workshop — Participant Reassignment
passages.body:
NOTICE TO DEPARTMENT COORDINATORS
Updated attendance and travel procedure

Following a review of registration numbers, the compliance workshop will be split into two sessions instead of one. The morning session is intended for employees who routinely handle confidential client records; all other registered staff will be assigned to the afternoon session.

Coordinators will receive revised participant rosters by October 21. Upon [1] _____ the roster, please check whether the employees listed under your department will be available at their assigned time. Requests for reassignment must be made before October 23.

Attendance remains compulsory, [2] _____ whether participants work at the main office or remotely. Anyone unable to attend either session must obtain written approval from a direct supervisor.

[3] _____, the coordinator should contact Training immediately so that the vacant seat can be offered to another employee. This helps us avoid ordering unnecessary printed materials.

Hotel and travel reservations should not be made until each person's session has been confirmed. [4] _____ Accordingly, any nonrefundable charges incurred without authorization will remain the employee's responsibility.
